Qwen3.8-27B-UD-Q3_K_XL.notes: Quality default, and the model the default upstream-mtp lane is tuned for. Unsloth Dynamic V3.0 3-bit (12.5 GiB of weights), Unsloth's own recommendation for 16 GB VRAM. 65536 is the MTP-safe cap: on the 16376 MiB RTX 4070 Ti SUPER with q4_0 K/V, flash attention and --spec-draft-n-max 3 it loads at 15205 MiB, leaving 1171 MiB free, and decodes at 66.3 tok/s. On the plain upstream lane the same model is ~1.0 GiB lighter and goes further: 32768 = 14046 MiB, 65536 = 14737, 98304 = 15427, 131072 = 15621 MiB, and 131072 was validated with a 120k-token prefill that answered a needle question correctly. So for contexts above 65536, switch to `wingpu runtime set upstream` and raise this with `wingpu model context`.

Qwen3.8-27B-UD-IQ2_M.notes: Long-context option. RUN THIS ON THE upstream LANE, NOT THE DEFAULT upstream-mtp LANE: `wingpu runtime set upstream`. Unsloth Dynamic V3.0 2-bit (9.6 GiB of weights), leaving far more room for KV cache. On the upstream lane it runs Qwen3.8's full native 262144 context on 16 GB with q4_0 K/V: a 250256-token prefill peaked at 15739 MiB (~640 MiB free) and answered a needle question correctly. Under upstream-mtp the MTP head adds ~1.0 GiB: it still loads at 262144 (16039 MiB, only ~340 MiB free) and short generations work at 63.0 tok/s, but that is below the ~500 MiB safety bar and leaves no room for the compute buffers a deep prefill needs, so a genuine 256k run would likely OOM. Either switch to the upstream lane for full context, or stay on upstream-mtp and drop this to 131072 or below. KV costs about 21.6 KiB/token because only 16 of 64 layers use full attention; the rest are Gated DeltaNet linear-attention layers with fixed-size recurrent state.
